quotations.old_english: God eáðe mæg ðone dolsceaðan dǽda getwǽfan
quotations.english: God may easily sever the doltish robber from his deeds

source_text: dol-sceaða, an; m: [dol foolish; sceaða a robber] A foolish or rash robber; tem&e-short;r&a-long;rius spoli&a-long;tor :-- God eáðe mæg ðone dolsceaðan dǽda getwǽfan God may easily sever the doltish robber from his deeds, Beo. Th. 962; B. 479.
